name: Wake Slider
description: Horizontal slider made of vertical bars. Dragging the handle creates a wave in the bars that scales with drag speed and trails behind the head, like a boat wake.
contents: Row of vertical bars that fill up to the current value
Optional crest overlay color on the wave peaks
Optional numeric value readout to the right
Invisible accessible slider button covering the track
behavior: Click or drag on the track to set the value, with pointer capture
Spring-driven head follows the value; bar heights swell with movement speed and settle flat at rest
Keyboard control with arrows, PageUp/PageDown, Home and End; jumps skip the animation
Respects reduced motion by disabling the wave
editableByProps: Range, step, initial or controlled value and change callback
Bar count, height, resting height and gap
Wave strength, reach, skew, glide and smoothing
Value readout and its format, disabled state, aria label, extra classes

needsCodeEdit.where: commitFromX function and the flex layout classes on the trackRef div
paint function, the lift calculation using Math.cos

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the readout text size or position
needsCodeEdit.where: The showValue span at the end of the returned JSX

fixed: Requires the motion package (motion/react) and Tailwind CSS
Fills the width of its parent (w-full); width is controlled by the container
Track has a minimum height of 44px for touch targets
Handles only horizontal pointer position and does not use touch scrolling (touch-none)
Bar count is fixed by prop, so many bars with small gaps can become very thin on 360px screens
Wave spring constants SETTLE, FULL_SPEED, MIN_REACH and FLAT are hardcoded
